attributeDescription: Name and address of the importer if the product is being imported
Regions where buyers can order the product from
Price at which you want to sell this listing
SKU ID is the identification number maintained by you to keep track of SKUs. This will be mapped with Makro Serial Number.
Time required to keep the product ready for courier pickup. Must be in days.
Brand refers to the name of the company under which the product is marketed and sold.
Height refers to the measurement from top to base or head to foot. Please ensure that values entered are in {qualifier}.
qualifierDescription: Height refers to the unit used to measure Height. Possible values are inch, cm, mm.

attributeDescription: Vehicle Brand refers to the brand of the vehicle that the product is compactible with.
Compatible Engine refers to the type of engine of the vehicle with which the accessories are compatible with.
Warranty Service Type refers to a brief description on the type of service available from Manufacturer as part for this Warranty.
Number of Mounting Holes refers to the number of holes for mounting in the product.
Other Dimensions refers to any additional information on the dimensions of the product that would be useful to a customer.

Search Keywords refers to the words which the customer might use to find a product. These keywords are tagged to the product and when the buyer searches with the appropriate search word(s), the nearest appropriate product is retrieved and displayed on Makro website. The search output is also based on multiple other factors such as Product Quality, Pricing, etc. Please enter a maximum of 5 keywords for this purpose.
Number of Teeth refers to the number of teeth a clutch sprocket has, can affect the gear ratio and also determines which type of go-kart chains it is compatible with.

Diameter refers to the length of the straight line passing from side to side through the centre of a body or figure, especially a circle or sphere. Please ensure that values entered are in {qualifier}.
qualifierDescription: Diameter refers to the unit used to measure Diameter. Possible values are inch, cm, mm.

attributeDescription: Packaging Type refers to the type of packing the products come in.
Weight refers to the weight of the product only, without packaging. Please ensure that values entered are in {qualifier}.
qualifierDescription: Weight - Weight refers to the weight used to measure the weight. Units should be filled only in singular form.

attributeDescription: Description refers to describing your product along with a list of products that are compatible with this product. Description is limited to 5000 characters (including spaces). It should not include any hyperlinks, additional offers, or promotion text.
exampleValue: Quality accessories for enhancing the performance and longevity of your vehicle's engine.

attributeDescription: Length refers to the measurement of an object or distance from one end to the other in a linear direction. Please ensure that values entered are in {qualifier}.
qualifierDescription: Length refers to the unit used to measure Length. Possible values are inch, cm, mm.

attributeDescription: Colour refers to the shade of the product as mentioned by the brand on the label or sales package. The value 'Multicolour' should be used if the product has a mix of colours that is 3 or more prominent colours on the product.
Material refers to the substance used to make Engine Parts Accessories

attributeDescription: Vehicle Model Name refers to the manufacturer model name of the vehicle that the product is compactible with.
Other Features refers to other additional features of the engine part accessory.
EAN refers to a 13 digit bar code. In case you have UPC, prefix 0 to make it 13 digits. EAN/UPC is limited to 13 characters (including spaces). If not applicable, Please leave it blank.
Model Number refers to the number assigned by the manufacturers to identify the different products that they offer.
Vehicle Type refers to the type of vehicle that the product is suitable for.
Operating Voltage refers to the nominal voltage that a car dash switch panel needs in order to function properly.
Vehicle Model Year refers to the manufacturing year of the Part.
Width refers to the breadth, broadness or wideness of a product. Please ensure that values entered are in {qualifier}.
qualifierDescription: Width refers to the unit used to measure Width. Possible values are inch, cm, mm.

attributeDescription: Warranty Summary refers to the brief description on the warranty details of the product. If a warranty cannot be provided, kindly fill No warranty available.
Fuel Type refers to the type of fuel used for the vehicle with which the accessories are compatible with.

Sales Package refers to of all the contents that are sold in the package. Please specify the package information along with the number of each content mentioned before the name. Data should be double colon (||) separated. For instance, the Sales Package of a bedding set will most likely consist of 1 Bedsheet||2 Pillow Covers||2 Cushion Covers.
Certifications refers to a document prepared by a notified body that describes and validates the authenticity and key characteristics of a product.
